newsitem.title: USA: Norstan names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Norstan names chief financial officer.

text.p: Norstan Inc said Tuesday it appointed Kenneth MacKenzie, 55, as executive vice president and chief financial officer effective June 2, 1997.
MacKenzie most recently served as vice president strategic alliances at Manpower Inc, the world's largest human resource services firm.

Cohen will develop a newly created Norstan Focused Executive Group to strengthen relationships with Norstan customers. He will retain his duties as vice chairman and member of the executive management team.
Norstan provides integrated voice, video and data services and equipment.
